timeout.title: Login timed out
timeout.description: The tado login code expired before it was approved. Submit to get a fresh code and try again.

abort.already_configured: This tado home is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to tado. Please try again.
abort.no_homes: No tado home was found on this account.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll tado for room state. Lower is fresher but uses more of your daily API request budget. Device and weather data are polled less often.

set_climate_timer.name: Set climate timer
set_climate_timer.description: Heat a room to a temperature until a time of day or for a duration, then automatically resume the schedule.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature to hold until the timer ends.

until.name: Until
until.description: Clock time to heat until (e.g. 22:00). If it has already passed today, it rolls over to tomorrow. Use this or Duration, not both.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to heat for (e.g. 2 hours). Use this or Until, not both.
